title: Sensor-outage robustness for wildfire prediction
description: Wildfire prediction models lack evaluation under realistic sensor outage patterns during emergency conditions.
why_existing_work_does_not_solve_it: Missing-sensor forecasting is not tested against wildfire-specific false alarm and response constraints.
minimum_experiment_needed: Mask weather stations and satellite features under outage scenarios and measure calibrated risk.
risk_that_gap_is_fake: Operational wildfire systems may include proprietary outage evaluation.
